inningMap.expectation: First-five side is the cleanest expression.
inningMap.watch: Do not wait for late rescue if the starter edge is gone.

inningMap.expectation: Only keep full-game exposure if the bridge is not leaking.
inningMap.watch: A bullpen mismatch turns this into a hedge spot.

inningMap.expectation: Closeout depends on lead size more than raw team rating.

marketImplications.side: Rays is more coherent as a side because the game shape mostly agrees with the projection.
marketImplications.first5: First-five can stay live if starter hold and top-order pressure both agree.
marketImplications.total: Over is allowed only if RF/totals backtest agrees with the line bucket.
marketImplications.firstInning: YRFI is the timing lane to compare against the side; modeled chance 76.6% YRFI.

rfLens.trustedUse: Use RF as a nonlinear totals/game-shape check first. Do not let it pick ML/F5 by itself yet.
rfLens.totalsRead: RF totals baseline has little to add when the line and projection are nearly equal.
rfLens.moneylineRead: RF moneyline history is not deployable; it can only flag disagreement for review.
rfLens.first5Read: RF first-five history is not deployable; use it as a timing warning, not a pick.
rfLens.firstInningRead: RF first-inning history is not deployable; keep it behind explicit early-run features.
